features_delivered: Phase roles registry (backend/services/research_factory/roles.py) mapping all 12 phases P00 to P11 to their strictly ordered, authentic 10-role subagent specifications with role names, codes, default providers, and token estimates
WaveDispatcher (backend/services/research_factory/wave_dispatcher.py) implementing single-transaction creation of exactly 10 unique slots per phase wave with status QUEUED
Payload snapshot hashing computing deterministic SHA-256 digests over input parameters, bound to both the phase and individual jobs
Durable queue management with priority, attempt count, slot numbering (1..10), and idempotency key deduplication to support crash recovery and replay
Idempotent replay logic returning existing phase wave records without double-enqueueing jobs
Phase status inspection API returning full 10-slot health breakdowns and is_complete_ten validation
Negative abuse defense: One role absent -> wave does not falsely count ten. Missing role or slot gap raises RoleIncompleteError and prevents database commit
